scale.caption: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-widest opacity-60

usage_rules: NEVER use gradients for backgrounds. Flat, clinical colors only.
Fail state should flash the entire screen red (#EF4444) for 100ms, then return to calm.
Success state should be a subtle green glow, not a confetti explosion.
Text must always have high contrast (APCA compliant).

TaskContainer.description: The main swipeable container using Framer Motion. Handles the 'TikTok' logic.
TaskContainer.specs: Must use AnimatePresence. Swipe threshold: 50px. Spring physics: stiffness 300, damping 30.

TaskCard.description: The individual task view. Full screen. Contains the specific mini-game.
TaskCard.specs: Absolute positioning. Centered content. Minimalist instructions at the top.

StatsOverlay.description: Floating stats (Attempts, Global Pass Rate) in the corner.
StatsOverlay.specs: Top-right or Bottom-right. Monospace font. Small text-xs. Semi-transparent background.

ShareDialog.specs: Use Shadcn Dialog/Drawer. Clean typography. 'Copy Link' button.

GameEngine.description: Logic for handling win/fail states, timers, and precision checks.
GameEngine.specs: Pure logic. No UI. Returns state objects.

assets.icons: Lucide React (already installed). Use: Share2, RefreshCw, Info, X, Check.
assets.sounds: Subtle clicks, low-frequency hums for failure, high-pitch ping for success. (Use Web Audio API or simple HTML5 Audio).

universal_guidelines: Do not use 'Game Over' screens. Reset instantly.
Instructions must be cryptic but solvable. Example: 'Wait.' instead of 'Wait for 5 seconds'.
Ensure 60fps performance. Avoid heavy blurs on mobile.
Mobile-first: Touch targets must be at least 44px.
Theme: Light mode default. Clinical, sterile, high-stakes.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a 'TikTok for Impossible Tasks'. Focus on the 'feel' of the swipe and the 'tightness' of the game loop. The UI is minimal; the code is complex. Use Framer Motion for everything. The backend is simple: store task IDs, attempts, and completions. Calculate rates on the fly.
